newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CS sugar output to July 16 - Unica.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CS sugar output to July 16 - Unica.

text.p: Results to July 16 of the 1997/98 sugar harvest in Brazil's centre-south region were as follows, said Unica, which has replaced the Association of Sugar and Alcohol Industries of Sao Paulo (AIAA).
Overall sugar cane production in the region is running slightly higher than last year.
In Sao Paulo state however, sugar cane output to July 16 was 2.16 percent below last year because of the heavy rains in the second half of May and during the month of June, Unica said.
Sugar output in Sao Paulo state was 4.55 percent lower than to the same stage last season but only 2.51 percent down on a regional basis.

Alcohol production in the state was however 4.76 percent above last year and 8.14 percent ahead taking into consideration the whole center-south region, showing a slight preference for alcohol production over sugar, it added.
